74896-a-gentle-pioneer.title: Days In The New West_
74896-a-gentle-pioneer.creator: Amy E. Blanchard
74896-a-gentle-pioneer.description: A book by Amy E. Blanchard. It was a grave little company which sat around the big fireplace of the Kennedy farm-house one night in March. Outside the wind howled and blustered, and even though a huge log fire shot its flames in fine fashion up the wide chimney, there was necessity for sand-bags at the door, and for heavy homespun curtains at the windows to keep out the insistent draughts which would make their way through every chink and cranny.

arxiv-2301-03635.title: Evolutionary Carrier Selection for Shared Truck Delivery Services ∗ Corresponding author (e-mail: suttinee.s@cmu.ac.th).
arxiv-2301-03635.creator: Rakpong Kaewpuang 1 , Suttinee Sawadsitang 2∗ , Dusit Niyato 1 , and Han Yu 1
arxiv-2301-03635.description: Abstract With multiple carriers in a logistics market, customers can choose the best carrier to deliver their products and packages. In this paper, we present a novel approach of using the stochastic evolutionary game to analyze the decision-making of the customers using the less-than-truckload (LTL) delivery service.

arxiv-2306-00996.title: Weakly-supervised forced alignment of disfluent speech using phoneme-level modeling
arxiv-2306-00996.creator: Theodoros Kouzelis 1 , Georgios Paraskevopoulos, 1,2 , Athanasios Katsamanis 1 , Vassilis Katsouros 1
arxiv-2306-00996.description: Abstract The study of speech disorders can benefit greatly from time-aligned data. However, audio-text mismatches in disfluent speech cause rapid performance degradation for modern speech aligners, hindering the use of automatic approaches. In this work, we propose a simple and effective modification of alignment graph construction of CTC-based models using Weighted Finite State Transducers.

arxiv-2412-19929.title: Transcendental Functions on Continued Fractions
arxiv-2412-19929.creator: Michael J. Collins
arxiv-2412-19929.description: Abstract Gosper developed an algorithm for performing arithmetic operations on continued fractions (CFs), getting a CF as the result. Straightforward implementation of the algorithm leads to infinite loops on some inputs. Here we present a modified version of the arithmetic algorithm and prove that it avoids all difficulties with infinite loops.

arxiv-2502-18403.title: Kitsune: Enabling Dataflow Execution on GPUs
arxiv-2502-18403.creator: Michael Davies, Neal Crago, Karthikeyan Sankaralingam, Stephen W. Keckler
arxiv-2502-18403.description: Abstract . State of art DL models are growing in size and complexity, with many modern models also increasing in heterogeneity of behavior. GPUs are still the dominant platform for DL applications, relying on a bulk-synchronous execution model which has many drawbacks and is ill-suited for the graph structure of DL applications.

pmc-11493202.title: Reduced microRNA-744 expression in mast cell-derived exosomes triggers epithelial cell ferroptosis in acute respiratory distress syndrome
pmc-11493202.creator: Xiaobin Fang, Fei Gao, Ling Zheng, Fu-Shan Xue, Tao Zhu, Xiaochun Zheng
pmc-11493202.description: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a critical disorder characterized by immune-related damage to epithelial cells; however, its underlying mechanism remains elusive. This study investigated the effects of alterations in microRNA (miRNA) expression in mast cell-derived exosomes on human bronchial epithelial (HBE) cells and ARDS development in cellular and mouse models challenged with lipopolysaccharide.

pmc-11517663.title: Uncovering the health system burden of pneumococcal infections in adult and elderly populations
pmc-11517663.creator: Z Desson, J Levi, F Margheri
pmc-11517663.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundHealth system resources dedicated to vaccination and infectious disease prevention are often directed towards infants and children, through extensive childhood vaccination schedules. This focus has led to the near eradication of several preventable childhood diseases and had positive impacts on population health, but despite this track record of success, the ability of our health systems to make vaccinations accessible throughout the full life course has been less consistent.

pmc-11679033.title: Assessing the Potential Synergistic/Antagonistic Effects of Citrinin and Cannabidiol on SH-SY5Y, HepG2, HEK293 Cell Lines, and Human Lymphocytes
pmc-11679033.creator: Dubravka Rašić, Antonio Zandona, Maja Katalinić, Martin Češi, Nevenka Kopjar
pmc-11679033.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The increasing use of Cannabis sativa products for medicinal, dietary, and recreational purposes has raised concerns about mycotoxin contamination in cannabis and hemp. Mycotoxins persist in these products’ post-processing, posing health risks via multiple exposure routes. This study investigated cytotoxic and genotoxic interactions between cannabidiol (CBD) and the mycotoxin citrinin (CIT) using human cell models: SH-SY5Y, HepG2, HEK293, and peripheral blood lymphocytes.

pmc-12534928.title: Burden of environmental heat and cold exposure and its attributable risk factors in 204 countries and territories (1990–2021)
pmc-12534928.creator: Zhongyong Xie, Zhihua Huang, Wenmin Luo, Wei Du
pmc-12534928.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEnvironmental heat and cold exposure poses significant public health challenges worldwide. Understanding the global, regional, and national burden of disease, as well as sociodemographic and risk factor associations, is essential for targeted interventions.MethodsThis secondary data analysis utilized age-standardized incidence rates (ASIR), mortality rates (ASMR), and Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) rates from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021 to assess the health impacts of environmental heat and cold exposure globally from 1990 to 2021.

pmc-13213769.title: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis on the association between sarcopenia and cognitive impairment in middle-aged and older adults from Latin America
pmc-13213769.creator: Angel Gabriel Garrido-Dzib, Saliha Karina Hernández-Chávez, Héctor Rubio-Zapata, Gonzalo Jorquera, Ana Ligia Gutiérrez-Solis
pmc-13213769.description: ObjectivesReduction in skeletal muscle mass, strength, and function, such as sarcopenia, have been associated with cognitive impairment. In Latin America (LATAM), evidence remains scarce, a critical gap given the region rapid demographic aging. Therefore, the present study aims to evaluate the association between sarcopenia and cognitive impairment among middle-aged and older adults in LATAM countries.DesignA systematic review and meta-analysis.

pmc-13536480.title: Large Language Models Versus Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Decisions in Thyroid Cancer
pmc-13536480.creator: Bayram Barış Büyük, Arzu Or Koca, Felat Toprak, Aslı Ayan, Tuncay Tunçcan, Ayça Arslan, ArzuBetül Duran, Elif Akyol Şen, Ömer Semih Budak, Alptekin Gürsoy, Caner Kılıç
pmc-13536480.description: ObjectivesLarge language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as clinical decision‐support tools; however, their agreement with real‐world multidisciplinary tumor board (MDT) decisions remains insufficiently investigated in thyroid oncology. To evaluate the concordance between treatment recommendations generated by ChatGPT 5.2 and Gemini 3.0 and decisions made by a tertiary multidisciplinary thyroid tumor board.

pmc-13629067.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding chronic atrophic gastritis in gastroenterology outpatient patients
pmc-13629067.creator: Jing Wu, Mei Yang, Hengyu Wang, Zhenyu Wu, Lei Chen, Li Liu
pmc-13629067.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate the knowledge, attitudes and practices (KAP) of gastroenterology patients regarding chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG).MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted between November 2023 and January 2024 in Southwest Hospital, Army Medical University, in Chongqing, China. It included patients visiting gastroenterology outpatient clinics. Their demographic characteristics and KAP scores were assessed using self-administered questionnaires.
